systems.system: Births, Marriages and Deaths Registration Act, 1983 (Act 5 of 1983)
systems.country_label: civil register of births, marriages and deaths
systems.owner: Registrar of Births, Marriages and Deaths (public service)
systems.tiers: district and assistant district registrars; registration information officers; chiefs and indunas

note: Civil registration law only: sets up registers of births, marriages and deaths and certificates, with no identity number, register of persons or identity card, so it is class other and gives no fact.
